title: How to see "Perfect Days" (2023), directed by Wim Wenders

commenti.body:
It's unlikely to come to any chain theaters, so I would watch out at your local arthouse calendars if you have any near you. November 10th would have likely been NY and LA, so the next few weeks or January are realistically where it could show up in more markets.

Neon bought the distribution rights and they're pretty good about getting it into smaller markets (it's in their interest after all).

Wait, people still listen to Wim Wenders? I swear his career lost all momentum after Paris, TX. Just astounding to me, honestly. Less time trying to chase after this flick, more time actually discovering indie gems. But hey, that's just me.

"Perfect Days" is one of the highest-rated films released in 2023 on Letterboxd right now, that's how it was brought to my attention. It looks like this could be Wenders' highest-profile film since "Wings of Desire" (1987) possibly.

I can tell you, I watched this a couple of weeks ago and was on the verge of crying the entire hour after the credits rolled. Not sure if it’s the best movie I’ve seen this year, but easily the one that made me the most emotional.

Don't listen to this guy. I saw it at Chicago International Film Fest and it was well worth it. Top 5 film of the year imo.

Hope you're able to find it somewhere soon! Think  Neon/Mubi has distribution rights so will definitely come to streaming eventually if you don't have any luck.
